steps.message: Add the following songs, in order, Endless Summer, Moonlight Sonata, Voices in the Hall to my playing queue in Retro music.

extra.finish_description: I could not reliably complete this under the no-UI-input constraint. I verified the songs exist and created an ordered playlist with: 1) Endless Summer, 2) Moonlight Sonata, 3) Voices in the Hall. However, Retro Music did not expose a verifiable command/content-provider path to append all three into its live playing queue; its media session still reported queue size=1.
